MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adjustable wall mount feels like a useful next step for my recently purchased 43-inch TV because it could help me position the screen, provided the mounting pattern and wall are suitable.",
    "TV connection accessories and camera storage relate to equipment I have used, so I understand the connection even when the specific products do not meet my current needs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI switch is relevant to connecting video devices, but its stated 1080p support would limit the 4K viewing setup suggested by my TV and Fire TV Stick.",
    "The memory cards require a device-specific compatibility check, and nothing in my recent activity establishes a need for extra cards or multiple packs.",
    "The tablet, portable speaker, trackball and hard drive case address needs I have not expressed; owning related electronics does not make those purchases useful now.",
    "Wi-Fi supports my cameras and streaming devices, but I would need an actual coverage or connection problem before choosing another router."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in electronics accessories, even when the accessories serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My camera purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to offer several memory cards without establishing which device needs one.",
    "My Fire TV use seems to have been extended into interest in an older Fire tablet, although watching television does not establish a need for a tablet."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent TV purchase makes practical setup improvements appealing, especially accessories that fit that specific television.",
    "My 4K TV and Fire TV Stick make support for 4K important when considering equipment in the video connection path.",
    "I choose accessories when they solve a concrete need and fit the equipment I own; a possible connection alone is not enough to make me buy."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in television and cameras but often substituted loosely related accessories for compatible products that solve a current need."
}
